verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Svelte accepts TypeScript in component scripts via lang="ts", and that `sv check` reports TypeScript compiler errors. Neither item says component props or emitted events get their types inferred automatically without annotations. General TypeScript support is an adjacent capability, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic type inference for component props and emitted events without writing extra type annotations
